capabilities: Turn selected image and video links into a swipeable gallery block
Reorder thumbnails by dragging and drop files in or out
Insert in-text references that jump to a figure
Open images in a zoomable, pannable full-size viewer
extras: Galleries are stored as fenced code blocks holding a JSON list, so images stay ordinary files; thumbnails and previews are kept outside the vault and deleted on uninstall. Interface available in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: Coming from Lite Gallery? Put the cursor in a litegal block and run Convert Lite Gallery at cursor.
problem: A note full of image links becomes a long column that is hard to browse, caption, and point to from the text.
summary: Image and video gallery block with a thumbnail strip, numbered captioned figures, in-text figure references, and a zoomable full-size viewer.
